ultimineshapeeditor.editor.help:
Left-click/drag: add or remove
Right-click/drag: remove
Scroll on grid: change layer

The grid is the face you mine, as you see it: top of grid = top of your screen. Gold = the block you mine. Layer 1 is that face, higher layers go deeper.

"Repeat from here" makes the layers from this one to your last drawn layer repeat forever. Layers before it are mined once, unless you set "In loop" to yes on them. Shift moves each repeat, e.g. Shift ↑ +1 on a one-layer loop makes a staircase.

Faint squares: previous layer. Orange dots: where this layer lands in the next repeat.

Only slots with a shape (green numbers) appear in the Ultimine shape menu.
